notes.title: New survival horror is in development...
Hotfix 1.03B
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug causing to load a bad ending instead of the 5th night. Now after the 4th night you will get to the 5th night and there you will be able to go to the bad or good ending.
- Fixed a bug where the ghost of a screaming girl could stop you forever, but not kill you. She will not be able to kill or stop you now.

notes.title: Bufix and balance changes 1.03.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I care about your opinion and always reading your reviews every day, thank you! I will try to fix all my mistakes and continue to follow your feedback! A patch was released today, fixing a very annoying bug as well as a balance changes.

- Monsters can no longer kill you through walls, also reduced their hitbox.
- Changed the location and size of the bloody word required to enter the code to make it easier to spot.
- An additional monster has been removed from the lab location.
- The hearing range of all monsters has been slightly reduced, as well as their sight range.
- One stationary monster from the 4th night has been removed.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.02a
notes.notes:
- Slightly lowered the difficulty of the 3rd and 5th nights ( now enemies won't go to you every time you pick up an artifact ).
- Fixed a bug that was causing to restart the 5th night instead of triggering a bad ending.
- Disabled the console, which was enabled by accident in the previous patch.

notes.title: Controller support.
notes.notes: - Added controller support ( if someone is still having the issues with controller, please write about it in steam discussions, this update has been tested on a PS5 controller and works well ).

notes.title: Announcing the game's release date!
notes.notes:
Hello, fans of horror games! I would like to inform you that the release date of the game is finally known.

[h1]February 20th! [/h1]

The release of my project will be a very exciting day for me, as this is my first game created [u]independently[/u]. I will write much more about it on the release date, but for now all that's left is to wait a little longer.
